name_en: Keihan — shredded chicken and toppings over rice with chicken broth poured tableside
summary_ja: 白ごはんにほぐし鶏や錦糸卵、パパイヤの味噌漬けをのせ、鶏ガラスープを注いでさらさらとかきこむ奄美地域の料理。薩摩藩の役人をもてなす膳として生まれたと伝わり、当初はスープなしの炊き込みご飯だったという。
summary_en: Shredded chicken, thread-thin egg, and papaya pickled in miso are laid over rice, then chicken broth is poured over the top to eat briskly. Said to have begun as a dish to entertain Satsuma-domain officials in Amami, it started out without the broth, as a chicken-mixed rice.
source_title: 鶏飯 鹿児島県｜うちの郷土料理

name_en: Karaimo gohan — sweet potato cubes cooked right into the rice, a taste of autumn
summary_ja: 角切りのさつまいもを米と一緒に炊きこむ、鹿児島の特産であるさつまいもの甘みを生かした一品。収穫期の9月から11月に多くつくられ、塩をひとつまみ加えると甘さが引き立つとされる。
summary_en: Cubed sweet potato is cooked right into the rice, built on a crop Kagoshima grows more of than anywhere else in Japan. It's made most often from September to November as the harvest comes in, and a pinch of salt is said to bring the sweetness forward.
source_title: からいもごはん 鹿児島県｜うちの郷土料理
